observed.failure: executed candidate binary was not observed
observed.mechanism: Launching /proc/controller/fd/N set the process comm name to N, so the frozen wrapper's ds4-server identity selector intentionally ignored it.

diagnosis: The authenticated bytes and retained model descriptor executed correctly, but a procfd binary pathname weakens both wrapper identity sampling and repository-wide pgrep -x ds4-server safety checks.
bounded_fix: Materialize the already-authenticated 5.13 MiB binary bytes into a private mode-0700 cache directory as an executable named ds4-server, verify its hash, and launch that named file. Keep the model on its retained descriptor and keep the frozen wrapper byte-identical.
